label: Whatever has received esse has an explanation of its presence at each moment of it
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (momentary principle of sufficient reason): in every history of the model, whatever has its esse received in some principle (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN) has, at every moment t at which it is present, some reason r that explains its being present at t (PresenceExplanation.Explains v r x t, the primitive of definition 261516e9; causal or not). Analyst formulation of the 'PSR or PSR-like explanatory principle' that Schmid 2021 (read; paragraph beginning 'And this discovery especially helps') says he accepts from Feser's argument, namely that something must explain the fact that an object continues to exist; restricted here to received-esse things to match the scope of 40a97664, and extended from continuing existence to every moment of presence, first moments and the moments of a beginningless thing included. No claim attributes this typed premise, or that extension, to him. Shared: Schmid's origin-or-inertia explanation (definition 8c20c988) satisfies it with no giver after onset (Control parts 1 and 4), and the sustaining interpretation satisfies it (part 5). It is not the world-indexed existence PSR of the contingency routes (TruthCore.Explanation.ExistencePSR), which has no moments.
